title: 魚道水理設計~Hydraulic design of fish passages
focus: 依魚種生命期解析通道水理、入口誘導與通過證據~Relating passage hydraulics and attraction to species, life stage and passage evidence
summary: 從水池落差、孔口流量與能量密度開始，接續游泳能力、入口誘導、休息區與篩網比較。課程不提供通用魚類流速標準，而要求把魚種、體長、季節和水溫寫入設計條件，並透過偵測率及多段通過率分析，區分水理可行性與真正的遷移成果。~Start with pool drops, opening discharge and energy density, then examine swimming ability, attraction, resting areas and screening. No universal fish velocity limit is supplied. Species, body size, season and temperature belong in the design conditions. Detection efficiency and passage through multiple reaches distinguish a hydraulically plausible facility from demonstrated migration outcomes.
history: NOAA 鮭科魚類通道手冊的官方目錄於二〇二三年刊載，附錄涵蓋水理評估及水池尺度。教材只使用已讀目錄範圍，未宣稱全文審查。二〇〇九年墾務局篩網評估指南提供另一類設施的量測比較。麥克納利水壩二〇一四年七鰓鰻原型通道則提醒不同魚種不能共用同一種通行假設。案例名稱與公開年代不會被當成假想試算的實測資料。~NOAA posted its salmonid passage manual directory in 2023, with appendices addressing hydraulic evaluation and pool dimensions. Only the reviewed directory scope is used here, without claiming a full manual review. The 2009 Reclamation screening evaluation guide supports comparison with a different facility type. A McNary lamprey prototype installed in 2014 illustrates why species need different passage assumptions. Named cases and public dates do not turn the independently chosen exercise inputs into field measurements.
example: 本課先用「池間落差與射流」建立原創假想基準，再以「開口流量與係數」檢查另一個控制機制。第一組輸入及結果為 g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s；第二組為 Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s。學員需在同一張工作表分列量綱、時間、位置與適用範圍，先核對守恆，再解釋為何兩個得數不能互相代替。最後以第三單元提出的量測設計驗證假設，並將超出模型能力的水理、生態或治理問題列為待研究項目；這些示例並非所列案例的現場實測。敏感度重算：固定 g=9.81 m/s2 與理想無損失假設，將 dh 從 0.15 m 增至 0.18 m，速度由 1.715517 m/s 增至 1.879255 m/s，約增加百分之九點五四。落差增加兩成而速度非增加兩成，且仍未判定魚種可通過性。~Begin with an original hypothetical baseline for Pool drops and jet velocity and examine another controlling mechanism through Opening discharge and coefficient. The first inputs and result are g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s; the second are Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s. Keep dimensions, time, location and validity conditions in separate columns of the same working sheet. Check conservation before explaining why the two numerical results cannot substitute for one another. Use the third unit measurement design to test assumptions and identify hydraulic, ecological or governance questions that exceed the model. These examples are not field observations from the named reference cases. Sensitivity recalculation: Keep g=9.81 m/s2 and the ideal loss-free assumption fixed while increasing dh from 0.15 m to 0.18 m. Velocity rises from 1.715517 m/s to 1.879255 m/s, approximately 9.54 percent. A twenty percent drop increase does not produce a twenty percent speed increase and still does not determine species passage suitability.

units.anchor: 池間落差與射流~Pool drops and jet velocity
units.title: 池間落差與射流~Pool drops and jet velocity
units.mechanism: 魚道各池之間的水頭差會轉成局部射流動能，分散總落差可以改變每一段的通行負擔。理想能量式只提供速度尺度，真實射流會收縮、耗散並與池內回流互動，不能用它代替魚所選路徑的速度。魚種、體長、水溫與游泳時間共同決定能力，短時爆發速度也不同於可持續速度。設計應先描述目標族群與季節，再把局部水理和可供停留的空間連成一條可走通的路徑。~Head difference between pools creates local jet energy, so dividing total fall changes the challenge at each passage. An ideal energy equation gives a velocity scale, while real jets contract, dissipate and interact with recirculation. It does not describe every route selected by a fish. Species, length, temperature and duration affect swimming ability, and burst speed differs from sustained speed. Define the target population and season before linking hydraulic conditions with connected resting opportunities.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s。適用邊界：忽略損失的局部速度尺度，不是魚種可通過限值或池內平均流速。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s. Applicable boundary: Local ideal velocity scale without losses, not a species passage limit or pool average.
units.verify: 同步量相鄰池水位，沿開口與魚可能游經區量測速度分布及水深。將瞬時峰值與時間平均分列，並記錄目標魚體長與水溫，避免把一支流速計的平均值當成完整通行環境。~Measure adjoining levels simultaneously and map velocity and depth across the opening and potential routes. Separate instantaneous peaks from time averages, recording fish length and water temperature so one meter average is not mistaken for the whole passage environment.
units.failure: 射流正面衝向下一開口可能形成連續高速走廊，讓魚無法休息。即使每池落差相同，也需檢查射流方向及避流區是否彼此連通。~A jet aimed directly at the next opening can create a continuous fast corridor without rest. Equal pool drops therefore still require checking jet orientation and connectivity between lower-velocity refuge areas.
units.misconception: 池間落差相同就代表所有魚種都具有相同通過機會~Equal pool drops give every fish species the same passage opportunity
units.practice: 將落差增加一倍重算理想速度，與速度也加倍的假設比較。畫出一條包含休息區的通行路徑，標示仍需取得的魚種能力及局部流速資料。~Double the drop and compare ideal velocity with a doubled-speed assumption. Draw a connected route including refuges and identify the species-performance and local velocity observations still needed to assess passage.

units.anchor: 開口流量與係數~Opening discharge and coefficient
units.title: 開口流量與係數~Opening discharge and coefficient
units.mechanism: 魚道開口把水位差轉為流量，流量係數濃縮了收縮與損失，但它會隨開口形狀、邊緣與淹沒狀態改變。用水深乘寬度建立面積之前，要確認開口是否完全被水淹沒，否則出流型態可能不同。相同流量可以經不同面積形成不同速度與剪切分布，因此滿足供水量並不等於滿足通行條件。控制計算應與入口誘導、下游尾水及池內水位一起閉合。~An opening converts level difference into discharge. Its coefficient represents contraction and losses but changes with geometry, edges and submergence. Before using width times height, verify that the opening is fully wetted; otherwise a different flow relation may apply. The same discharge through different areas produces different velocities and shear distributions, so supplying enough water does not establish passage suitability. Close the calculation with attraction flow, tailwater and pool levels instead of treating one opening independently.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s。適用邊界：完全淹沒開口與給定有效係數，未把係數當通用常數。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s. Applicable boundary: Fully submerged opening with an assumed effective coefficient, not a universal coefficient.
units.verify: 在多組水位差下量測流量，反算有效係數並檢查是否隨尾水改變。量開口實際尺寸及邊緣損傷，將堵塞與未堵塞資料分開；若係數不穩定，應辨認流態轉換而非只取全部平均。~Measure discharge over several head differences and infer the effective coefficient, checking tailwater dependence. Survey actual dimensions and edge damage. Separate blocked and clear conditions; unstable coefficients call for identifying regime changes rather than averaging every observation together.
units.failure: 枝葉堵住部分開口會改變流量與局部高速區，可能使其他池水位也偏離預期。只按閘門開度推流量會漏掉堵塞造成的網路連鎖反應。~Debris can reduce opening area while changing local jets and levels in adjoining pools. Inferring discharge solely from gate position misses these blockage effects and their propagation through the connected passage system.
units.misconception: 流量係數一旦量到就不會隨開口堵塞或尾水改變~A measured discharge coefficient never changes with blockage or tailwater
units.practice: 使有效開口寬度縮小四分之一重算流量，再討論水位差可能隨之改變的情況。列出應同步觀測的池水位，說明為何單一開口不能獨立調整。~Reduce effective width by one quarter and recalculate discharge, then discuss possible changes in head difference. Identify pool levels that require simultaneous observation and explain why one opening cannot always be adjusted independently.

units.anchor: 池體積與平均能量密度~Pool volume and mean energy density
units.title: 池體積與平均能量密度~Pool volume and mean energy density
units.mechanism: 流量跨越水頭差釋出的功率除以池體積，可形成平均體積能量耗散尺度，方便比較不同配置。這個平均數不表示能量在空間均勻分布，入口射流、渦流中心與底部角落可能差異很大。有效參與混合的水體也可能小於幾何池容，死水區增加體積卻未改善通行。魚類反應還受紊流尺度與方向影響，因此平均功率密度須搭配流場和行為觀察，不應單獨作成效判決。~Discharge falling through a head difference releases power; dividing by pool volume gives a mean volumetric dissipation scale for comparing layouts. Dissipation is not spatially uniform: jets, vortex cores and corners differ. The actively mixed volume may be smaller than geometric volume, so dead zones can enlarge a pool without improving passage. Fish also respond to turbulence scale and direction. Pair the average power density with flow mapping and behaviour instead of making it the sole performance criterion.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=0.25 m3/s; dh=0.15 m; V=3.5 m3; Pv=rho*g*Q*dh/V=105.107143 W/m3。適用邊界：假設該水頭功率全在所列池容內耗散，非魚種允許值。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=0.25 m3/s; dh=0.15 m; V=3.5 m3; Pv=rho*g*Q*dh/V=105.107143 W/m3. Applicable boundary: Assumes the head power dissipates within the stated pool volume; not a species acceptance limit.
units.verify: 量實際池容並排除淤積占據空間，將水位及流量同步記錄。以流場測量辨認射流核心與死水區，再觀察魚是否使用預期休息區；平均值降低但局部仍猛烈時，需改配置而非只加池深。~Measure usable volume after sediment accumulation and synchronize levels with discharge. Map jet cores and dead zones, then observe refuge use. If average power decreases while local turbulence remains intense, revise layout rather than simply deepening the pool.
units.failure: 池底淤積會減少有效體積，使原計算低估平均耗散；另一方面，大死水區也會掩蓋集中紊流。檢查時需同時看淤積地形與主流混合範圍。~Sediment reduces usable volume and can invalidate the original average dissipation estimate. Large inactive zones can also conceal concentrated turbulence, requiring inspection of both deposited material and the region actively mixed by the jet.
units.misconception: 平均功率密度相同就代表池內每個位置紊流程度相同~Equal average power density means identical turbulence at every point in a pool
units.practice: 假設淤積占去半立方公尺重算功率密度，另畫一個總體積更大但死水區更多的池。提出能區分兩種改善是否有效的流場與魚行為量測。~Remove half a cubic metre of usable volume and recalculate power density. Sketch a larger pool with more inactive space and propose hydraulic and behavioural measurements that distinguish genuine improvement from a misleading volume increase.

units.anchor: 游泳速度與地面進度~Swimming speed and ground progress
units.title: 游泳速度與地面進度~Swimming speed and ground progress
units.mechanism: 魚相對水的游泳速度與水流相對地面的速度是不同參考系，逆流時兩者相減才是向上游的地面進度。若水流接近可維持游速，通過時間會急遽增加；水流更快時，簡化模型便無正向進度。魚可能利用邊界層或間歇爆發，真實軌跡不能由單一平均速度完整描述。計算應把可維持時間與距離一起列出，並明示水溫及體長條件，避免以最高速度替代耐力。~Swimming speed relative to water differs from progress relative to the bank. Against a uniform current, subtract flow speed to obtain upstream ground speed. As current approaches sustainable swimming speed, travel time rises sharply; a faster current gives no positive progress in this simplified model. Fish may use boundary layers or bursts, so an average cannot represent every trajectory. State duration, distance, temperature and body size rather than substituting maximum speed for endurance.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Us=1.2 m/s upstream-relative-water; U=0.8 m/s downstream; L=6 m; t=L/(Us-U)=15 s。適用邊界：一維定常逆流與固定可維持游速，未包括轉向與疲勞。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Us=1.2 m/s upstream-relative-water; U=0.8 m/s downstream; L=6 m; t=L/(Us-U)=15 s. Applicable boundary: One-dimensional steady counterflow with fixed sustainable swimming speed, excluding turns and fatigue.
units.verify: 先確認游泳能力資料的魚種、體長、水溫及試驗持續時間，再於候選路徑量流速。以追蹤影像取得地面位移與停留時間，若魚利用邊界低速帶，應沿實際路徑比較而非套斷面平均。~Check species, size, temperature and test duration behind the swimming input, then measure current along candidate routes. Use tracking to obtain ground displacement and pauses. Fish using low-velocity boundaries should be assessed along their actual trajectories.
units.failure: 以短時爆發游速估整段長距離通過，會低估疲勞與退回的機會。觀察到魚反覆嘗試後下退時，需檢查持續時間而不只檢查最大流速。~Using burst speed for a long reach underestimates fatigue and retreat. Repeated attempts followed by downstream movement call for examining endurance and resting opportunities, not merely the maximum local current.
units.misconception: 魚相對水的游速就是它相對岸邊的上游移動速度~A fish's swimming speed relative to water is its upstream speed relative to the bank
units.practice: 將水流提高到每秒一公尺重算時間，再試每秒一點二公尺並解釋分母為零的物理意義。列出可用來驗證固定游速假設的追蹤資料。~Raise current to one metre per second and recalculate travel time, then examine current equal to swimming speed. Explain the zero denominator physically and identify tracking data that test the fixed-speed assumption.

units.anchor: 入口誘導流量比例~Attraction flow proportion
units.title: 入口誘導流量比例~Attraction flow proportion
units.mechanism: 魚道入口需讓目標魚在多股水流中辨認可接近的路徑，誘導流量只是其中一個因素。入口位置、尾水深度、射流方向與附近洩流都會改變魚是否找到入口。流量占河川總流量的比例能描述供水分配，卻不直接量化入口可見度或魚的選擇。相同占比在不同洪水與機組運轉條件下可能產生不同流場，因此應把入口尋找與進入後通過分成兩個評估階段。~Attraction flow helps fish locate an accessible entrance among competing currents, but location, tailwater depth, jet direction and nearby releases also matter. Its fraction of river discharge describes water allocation, not entrance detectability or fish choice. Identical fractions can create different flow patterns during floods or generating-unit changes. Evaluate finding the entrance separately from passing through the facility, and examine the operating conditions that alter approach routes rather than assuming a fixed ratio guarantees attraction.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Qa=0.6 m3/s; Qr=40 m3/s; fa=Qa/Qr=0.015 dimensionless。適用邊界：僅為指定時刻水量比例，不是普遍建議值或吸引成功率。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Qa=0.6 m3/s; Qr=40 m3/s; fa=Qa/Qr=0.015 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: A discharge fraction at one specified time, not a universal recommendation or attraction success rate.
units.verify: 於入口外布設流速測線，記錄河川流量及附近出口操作，同時追蹤魚到達、搜尋與進入時間。將未找到入口與進入後退出分開統計，並比較不同尾水條件，避免把兩種失敗混成一個通過率。~Map approach velocities and record river flow and nearby outlet operation while tracking arrival, search and entry times. Separate failure to find the entrance from retreat after entry, comparing tailwater conditions rather than combining both into one passage statistic.
units.failure: 誘導射流可能被主流偏轉，讓魚聚集在無法進入的位置。此時增加同方向流量未必改善，需查入口位置與可達水深，而不是只提高占比。~The main current can deflect an attraction jet toward an inaccessible location. Increasing discharge in the same direction may not help; investigate entrance placement and accessible depth instead of only increasing the fraction.
units.misconception: 誘導流量占比就是到達魚道入口的魚類成功百分比~Attraction discharge fraction equals the percentage of fish that successfully find the entrance
units.practice: 將河川流量加倍但誘導流量不變，重算比例並說明它不能直接預測成效減半。設計一個同時量水流及搜尋時間的比較試驗，控制魚種與季節。~Double river discharge at unchanged attraction flow and recalculate the fraction without assuming success halves. Design a comparison measuring both currents and search time while controlling species and season across observations.

units.anchor: 水池換水與魚類停留~Water turnover and fish residence
units.title: 水池換水與魚類停留~Water turnover and fish residence
units.mechanism: 池容除以流量得到名義換水時間，可作水體更新的尺度，但真實水粒子停留時間會因短路與回流形成分布。魚不是被動示蹤物，可能主動停留、避流或反覆進出，所以水的平均換水時間不能代替魚類恢復體力的時間。溶氧與水溫也受外界交換影響，不能只靠較大體積假定適合休息。課程應把幾何池容、有效混合體積與觀測到的行為時間分開記錄。~Pool volume divided by discharge gives nominal water turnover time, while short-circuiting and recirculation produce a distribution of particle residence times. Fish are active organisms that can rest, avoid currents or repeatedly enter and leave; hydraulic turnover therefore does not equal recovery time. Oxygen and temperature depend on additional exchanges, so larger volume alone does not establish refuge quality. Keep geometric volume, actively mixed volume and observed behavioural residence as distinct quantities in the assessment.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：V=8 m3; Q=0.4 m3/s; tn=V/Q=20 s。適用邊界：名義水體換水尺度，未假設每隻魚或每個水粒子停留二十秒。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: V=8 m3; Q=0.4 m3/s; tn=V/Q=20 s. Applicable boundary: Nominal water turnover scale, without assuming every fish or water particle remains twenty seconds.
units.verify: 用適合現場且獲准的示蹤方式量入口與出口濃度曲線，檢查早到峰與長尾。同步追蹤魚停留分布並量水溫、溶氧，將水力短路與魚主動休息區分，不能只用一個平均時間判斷池體功能。~Use an appropriate authorized tracer method to measure inlet and outlet concentration histories, looking for early peaks and long tails. Track fish residence alongside temperature and oxygen, distinguishing hydraulic short-circuiting from active resting rather than relying on one mean.
units.failure: 主流直接穿池可能使大部分水快速離開，而角落長時間不更新。若只看池容除流量，會同時漏掉高速通道與低氧死水區的問題。~Flow can short-circuit across a pool while corner water renews slowly. Volume divided by discharge alone then conceals both a fast corridor and stagnant areas that may develop unsuitable oxygen conditions.
units.misconception: 名義換水時間就是所有魚必須在池中停留的時間~Nominal water turnover time is the time every fish must remain in the pool
units.practice: 保持流量不變將池容增加四分之一重算名義時間，畫兩條平均相近但形狀不同的示蹤曲線。說明哪種附加量測可辨認真正可用的休息空間。~Increase volume by one quarter at fixed flow and recalculate nominal time. Sketch two tracer curves with similar means but different shapes, then identify additional observations that reveal usable resting space for fish.

units.anchor: 篩網接近速度比較~Screen approach velocity comparison
units.title: 篩網接近速度比較~Screen approach velocity comparison
units.mechanism: 取水篩網與上溯魚道目的不同，前者常需避免魚被吸附或帶入取水口，不能把魚道開口流速直接當成篩網標準。接近速度應相對篩網法向定義，而掃流沿網面方向，兩者對魚的作用不同。以總流量除有效開孔面積得到孔隙平均速度，與按整體網面積計算的表觀速度也不同。教材必須明確標示所用面積和速度定義，才能與指定魚種及生命期的評估方法比較。~Intake screens and upstream fish passages serve different purposes; a passage-opening velocity cannot simply become a screen criterion. Approach velocity is normal to the screen, while sweeping velocity runs along it. Dividing discharge by effective open area gives a mean opening velocity, distinct from superficial velocity based on gross screen area. State both area and velocity definitions explicitly before comparing with an evaluation method for a particular species and life stage or interpreting blockage effects.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Q=0.9 m3/s; Ag=3 m2; phi=0.6 dimensionless; vp=Q/(Ag*phi)=0.5 m/s。適用邊界：均勻法向通流的孔隙平均速度，不與總網面表觀接近速度混稱。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Q=0.9 m3/s; Ag=3 m2; phi=0.6 dimensionless; vp=Q/(Ag*phi)=0.5 m/s. Applicable boundary: Mean opening velocity for uniform normal flow, distinct from gross-area superficial approach velocity.
units.verify: 先記錄網面總面積、開孔比例及堵塞分布，再依評估方法在網前規定位置量法向與切向速度。比較孔隙平均與表觀速度時標出定義，避免把兩種不同面積基準的數字當成儀器不一致。~Record gross area, open fraction and blockage pattern, then measure normal and tangential velocities at locations specified by the evaluation method. Label opening and superficial velocities explicitly so different area bases are not mistaken for inconsistent instruments.
units.failure: 局部堵塞會把流量集中到剩餘開孔，平均全網速度可能仍低卻出現高吸附區。診斷應看空間分布及清污狀態，不能只查總取水量。~Local blockage concentrates flow through remaining openings even when the gross-area average appears modest. Investigate spatial velocity patterns and cleaning condition rather than relying solely on total intake discharge or nominal screen area.
units.misconception: 孔隙平均速度與按總網面積計算的表觀速度永遠相同~Opening velocity and superficial velocity based on gross screen area are always identical
units.practice: 將開孔比例降低到零點四重算孔隙速度，另算總網面表觀速度並比較。畫出局部堵塞可能形成的高流速區，說明應如何加密量測而非只取平均。~Reduce open fraction to zero point four and recalculate opening velocity, then compare with gross-area superficial velocity. Sketch a blockage-induced fast region and propose denser measurements instead of relying only on the average.

units.anchor: 渦流尺度與魚體尺度~Eddy scales and fish size
units.title: 渦流尺度與魚體尺度~Eddy scales and fish size
units.mechanism: 紊流不只由速度大小決定，渦流的空間尺度、持續時間及方向都可能影響魚維持姿態的能力。以特徵長度除以速度擾動可建立周轉時間尺度，但這不是魚的疲勞時間，也不是特定物種的允許週期。渦流尺寸相對魚體長度可能改變作用方式，因此測量應保留空間與時間解析度。過度平均會消除瞬時結構，反之短紀錄又可能把偶發渦流當成代表狀態，需要兼顧兩者。~Turbulence affects posture through spatial scale, duration and direction as well as velocity magnitude. Dividing a characteristic length by velocity fluctuation gives an eddy turnover scale, not fish fatigue time or a species acceptance period. Eddy size relative to body length can change the interaction, so measurements need suitable spatial and temporal resolution. Excessive averaging removes transient structures, whereas very short records may mistake a rare event for typical conditions; both sampling limits require attention.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：ell=0.4 m; uprime=0.2 m/s; te=ell/uprime=2 s。適用邊界：量綱尺度估算，非完整紊流頻譜或魚類生理反應模型。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: ell=0.4 m; uprime=0.2 m/s; te=ell/uprime=2 s. Applicable boundary: Dimensional scale estimate, not a complete turbulence spectrum or physiological response model.
units.verify: 在魚可能利用的路徑採集足夠長的高速流速序列，說明取樣頻率與探頭空間。比較不同位置的變動與相干性，再將影像中的魚體轉向和時間序列對齊，避免只憑均速推論紊流影響。~Collect sufficiently long high-rate velocity records along likely routes, documenting sampling frequency and probe spacing. Compare fluctuations and coherence across locations, then align fish turning observations with the records rather than inferring turbulence effects from mean velocity alone.
units.failure: 探頭取樣過慢會漏掉快速擾動，過大的空間平均又會抹平渦流。若魚明顯失衡而紀錄平穩，應先查解析度及位置，而非否定行為觀察。~Slow sampling can miss rapid fluctuations, and broad spatial averaging can erase eddies. If fish lose posture while records appear smooth, examine resolution and location before dismissing the behavioural evidence as unreliable.
units.misconception: 相同平均流速就代表魚會遭遇相同尺度與方向的紊流~Equal mean velocity means fish encounter turbulence of identical scale and direction
units.practice: 將擾動速度增加一倍重算周轉尺度，並比較兩種魚體長度與渦流尺寸的相對大小。提出能檢驗姿態變化與水流擾動時間關係的同步觀測方案。~Double fluctuation velocity and recompute turnover scale. Compare eddy size with two fish lengths and propose synchronized observations that test the timing between hydraulic fluctuations and changes in fish posture along the route.

units.anchor: 偵測效率與通過比例~Detection efficiency and passage proportion
units.title: 偵測效率與通過比例~Detection efficiency and passage proportion
units.mechanism: 上下游感測站看到的魚數同時受到真實通過及偵測效率影響，直接相除可能把儀器差異誤認為生物損失。用已估偵測機率修正計數，是在同一受追蹤族群、單次計數及相容觀測期間下的簡化估計。重複通過、標記脫落與不同魚種的可偵測性會破壞這些假設。分析需保存個體識別及時間順序，並把尋找入口、進入和完成通過分別定義，才能解釋比例代表什麼。~Counts at upstream and downstream detectors combine actual passage with detection efficiency, so a raw ratio can mistake instrumentation differences for biological loss. Correcting counts by estimated detection probabilities is a simplified estimator for one tracked cohort, unique counts and compatible observation windows. Repeated passages, tag loss and species-dependent detectability violate those assumptions. Preserve individual identities and event order, and distinguish attraction, entry and completed passage so the estimated proportion has a clear denominator and interpretation.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Nu=80 fish; pu=0.8 dimensionless; Nd=100 fish; pd=0.9 dimensionless; phat=(Nu/pu)/(Nd/pd)=0.9 dimensionless。適用邊界：同一族群唯一個體計數與已知偵測機率的簡化估計，不含估計不確定性。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Nu=80 fish; pu=0.8 dimensionless; Nd=100 fish; pd=0.9 dimensionless; phat=(Nu/pu)/(Nd/pd)=0.9 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: Simplified same-cohort unique-count estimator with known detection probabilities, excluding estimation uncertainty.
units.verify: 以重複天線或獨立影像估偵測效率，檢查漏測是否隨流量、魚體大小或標記方向改變。清理重複個體並對齊觀測窗，另報修正比例的不確定性，若結果超過一應查假設而非強制截斷掩蓋問題。~Estimate detection with redundant antennas or independent imagery and test dependence on discharge, size and tag orientation. Deduplicate individuals and align observation windows. Report uncertainty; estimates above one require investigating assumptions rather than silently truncating the result.
units.failure: 下游偵測效率較低時，分母被低估會誇大通過率。若把反覆往返同一魚當不同個體，還可能得到表面大於全部進入數的錯誤成果。~Poor downstream detection reduces the denominator and inflates apparent passage. Counting repeated movements of one fish as separate individuals can further produce an implausible number of successes relative to the original cohort.
units.misconception: 上下游原始計數相除必然等於真實通過機率~Dividing raw upstream by downstream counts necessarily gives the true passage probability
units.practice: 將上游偵測率改成零點九重算並與原始比例比較。列出需要保留的個體欄位，再設計一項檢查以辨認漏測、重複計數與真正未通過三種情況。~Change upstream detection probability to zero point nine and compare the corrected and raw ratios. List required individual records and design a check separating missed detections, repeated counts and genuine failure to complete passage.

units.anchor: 多段通行的累積效果~Cumulative passage across reaches
units.title: 多段通行的累積效果~Cumulative passage across reaches
units.mechanism: 流域中的多個障礙會把單處看似很高的通過率累積成較低的整體成功率，但乘法必須使用相容的條件機率。若每段數值是已到達該段魚群的通過機率，連乘可表示依序完成的比例；若只是不同調查族群的平均值，就未必可直接相乘。等待與繞行也會延長遷移時間，即使最後通過仍可能錯過繁殖窗口。改善排序應同時考慮瓶頸、時序與族群差異，而非只追求單處漂亮數字。~Multiple barriers can turn high local passage into modest basin-wide success, but multiplication requires compatible conditional probabilities. If each value describes fish that actually reach that stage, their product represents sequential completion; averages from unrelated populations need not be compatible. Delays and detours also matter because eventual passage can miss a breeding window. Prioritize improvements using bottlenecks, timing and population differences rather than optimizing one attractive local percentage without considering the connected migration route.
units.model: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：p=0.9 dimensionless conditional-stage-probability; N=5 stages; Pall=p^N=0.59049 dimensionless。適用邊界：五段條件通過率皆給定相同值；若視為邊際率則另需獨立性假設。~Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: p=0.9 dimensionless conditional-stage-probability; N=5 stages; Pall=p^N=0.59049 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: All five conditional stage probabilities are assumed equal; using marginal rates instead would additionally require independence.
units.verify: 對同一標記族群建立各段到達及通過的時間表，分母使用真正到達該段的個體。檢查魚體狀態與季節是否逐段改變，將累積成功與總延遲分開報告，並追查失聯是否只是偵測不足。~Build arrival and completion histories for the same tagged cohort, using actual arrivals as each denominator. Check changing condition and season across stages. Report cumulative completion separately from total delay and investigate whether disappearance reflects inadequate detection rather than loss.
units.failure: 某段延遲可能改變下一段面對的流量或季節，讓從其他年份搬來的局部通過率不適用。只連乘公布百分比會忽略這種跨段與跨時影響。~Delay at one barrier can change the flow or season encountered next, invalidating local rates borrowed from another year. Multiplying published percentages without cohort and timing checks can therefore misrepresent cumulative migration outcomes.
units.misconception: 每一段通過率都是九成所以五段全部通過率仍是九成~If each stage passes ninety percent, passage through all five is still ninety percent
units.practice: 將其中一段條件通過率提高到零點九八重算全程比例，再比較減少等待時間但不改通過率的方案。說明兩種效益需要哪些不同觀測才能評估。~Raise one conditional stage probability to zero point nine eight and recompute completion. Compare this with reducing delay at unchanged passage probability, identifying the different observations required to evaluate these two benefits.
